slides.title:
Awareness
is you
slides.subtitle: What the old texts say about the one who sees

slides.label: Shiva Sutras 1.1 · Kashmir Shaivism
body: The first line of the Shiva Sutras. Everything after it grows from this.

slides.label: Brihadaranyaka Upanishad 3.7.23
slides.quote:
Unseen, it sees.
Unheard, it hears.
Unknown, it knows.
body: You can never look at it. It is the one doing the looking.

slides.label: Mandukya Upanishad 7
slides.title: The fourth
slides.closing: sa ātmā · That is the Self

slides.label: Yoga Sutras 1.3
slides.quote: Then the seer rests in its own nature.
body: When the mind goes quiet, the one who was watching is all that is left.

slides.label: In Jyotish · Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 3.12
slides.title:
The Sun is the Self.
The Moon is the mind.
body: The Moon has no light of its own. It shines with the Sun’s. So does your mind.

slides.label: Try it · Ramana Maharshi’s question
slides.title: Who am I?
slides.closing: The answer is the one who asked

slides.title:
Thoughts come and go.
You stay.
slides.subtitle: Awareness is you
